snapshot_scope: Source/restoration index only; qualification and publication state are separate from source identity.

changes: ucode scan event, interface, deadline and request-error ownership
deferred supplicant reservations follow retained native ownership with acknowledged retirement
numeric nl80211 interface identity with backward-compatible dev selector
executable ucode CLI propagates scan failure
privileged C scans use active wildcard nl80211 requests and captured-interface completion/abort status
rpcd and LuCI preserve backend failures and valid empty scan results with matching package floors
native_scan_consumer_corrections.correlation_contract: Native interface correlation only: ordinary scan multicast has IFINDEX/WDEV, without a unique request cookie. The finite budget covers scan-event observation; ordinary metadata/ACK/dump transport is unchanged.
